ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; dominant low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with sparse high-intensity (white) focal points constituting less than 10% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Absence of large contiguous geometric blobs; pigmentation is characterized by a uniform dark field populated by discrete, localized high-contrast white focal spots (2-5 pixel radius) distributed semi-randomly across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide obtuse V-shaped depression; central vertex is clear; shallow depth relative to total fluke wingspan.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge; right lobe exhibits higher amplitude peaks and valleys compared to the left; pixel-level jaggedness is visible against the ocean background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a consistent concavity transitioning from the distal tips toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white pixel groups (rosettes) distributed across the ventral surface, likely corresponding to sessile cirripede attachment sites or subsequent scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible on the inner-left lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent brown/tan-colored textured masses located at the distal extremities (tips) of both fluke lobes, characterized by high-relief pixel clusters and significant color deviation from the primary fluke pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized water droplet artifacts and trailing spray captured mid-descent near the right distal tip.
